title: 2 Player Dark Racing
desc: Get your vehicle and race it on the tracks against different drivers. In this 2 Player Dark Racing game, you can play against your friends in the 2-player split-screen or single-player mode.
howto: Use Arrow Keys (Player 1) or WASD (Player 2) to Drive
tips: Agree on controls before the round starts.
Defense wins grudge matches — stay patient.
